usage.applicability: Mechanics-only L10 completion contracts using paired motion or independent outcome evidence; no live haptic authority.
usage.source_scope: 用触觉结果回路验证门功能是否真正发生。
usage.project_application: 作为 completion 设计原则并已落入 core:assist：配对 RGB-D 微运动只形成 UNKNOWN/SET_VALUED/LOCKED 动作信念；HANDOFF_READY 还必须联合 position、visibility、grounding、orientation、reachability。
usage.modifications: BlindAssist 当前无机器人触觉；以 Horn 刚体拟合、实体/帧/时钟/新鲜度准入和显式用户确认替代机器人闭环，不声称可直接实现 DoorBot。
usage.expected_effect: 阻止静态动作猜测、旧帧、多解动作点或单一接近姿态越权成为 HANDOFF_READY 或任务完成。

evaluation.setup: SceneFun3D 421013 action-geometry mechanics canary; evaluator motion annotations generated fixed 2 cm translations or 5 degree rotations over up to 128 paired functional points with 1.5 mm noise; the causal estimator saw only before/after points.
evaluation.effect: SC14 improved motion-type correctness from 7/8 static to 8/8 causal; translational direction hits from 4/7 to 7/7; mean direction error from 38.89 to 0.91 degrees; the single rotational axis passed and pivot-line error was 2.22 cm.
metrics: translation_direction_hit=4/7 static vs 7/7 causal at 15 degrees
evaluation.claim_boundary: Mechanics-only adaptation of the independent-outcome principle plus a runtime fail-closed contract. SceneFun3D generated the motion and evaluator supplied point correspondences; no live paired-RGB-D provider, robot haptics, natural RGB-D tracking, safe user probe, reachability, arrival, product benefit, or safety was established. The code can authorize HANDOFF_READY only after all endpoint conditions are separately ready; it does not show that they are achievable.

evidence.summary: Primary source reviewed for mechanism and evidence boundary; no BlindAssist reproduction is implied.
Pure-Kotlin causal rigid-motion estimator, evidence admission, and five-condition handoff readiness join.

history.change: Added from the user-provided directed literature review as a candidate only; no route authority or experimental result was created.

Executed the causal-outcome adaptation after SC12 and SC13 showed that static task/geometry axes were insufficient. The next source must provide natural before/after RGB-D motion or an explicitly authorized benign interaction; static action-axis tuning is closed.

Landed the SC14 representation in core:assist and made HANDOFF_READY require a current five-condition endpoint join plus a LOCKED causal action belief; explicit user confirmation remains the only completion authority.
